claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: ICI-192605 is a thromboxane receptor antagonist with no cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity described; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: ICI-192605 is a thromboxane receptor antagonist with no cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity described; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
